stem:
Read these sentences from paragraph 3.

She shakes Ashoke's hand and tells him that there are two other Indian children at the school, Jayadev Modi in the third grade and Rekha Saxena in fifth. Perhaps the Gangulis know them?

These sentences imply that Mrs. Lapidus —

options.label: A
options.text: has made assumptions about the Gangulis because they are Indian American

options.label: B
options.text: wants to reassure the Gangulis that Gogol will feel welcome among his Indian classmates

options.label: C
options.text: is familiar with the Indian naming traditions that the Gangulis follow

options.label: D
options.text: has worried about how the Gangulis will fit into the Indian American community at school
